title: Pakistan Calls Israel's Refusal to Withdraw from Gaza a 'Serious Setback'
detail: Pakistan publicly condemned Israel's refusal to withdraw forces from Gaza, describing it as a 'serious setback' to peace efforts. Islamabad's statement adds a prominent Muslim-world diplomatic voice to growing international pressure on stalled ceasefire negotiations, signaling broader solidarity against Israel's continued military presence.

media.caption: Pakistan condemns Israel's refusal to withdraw from Gaza as a serious setback to peace

title: Hamas Denounces Israel for Killing Top Gaza Police Official in Targeted Strike
detail: Hamas condemned Israel for carrying out a targeted strike that killed a senior Gaza police official. The killing drew sharp condemnation from Hamas, which accused Israel of deliberately targeting civil security personnel. The strike underscores continued Israeli operations against Hamas-affiliated security and administrative figures in Gaza.

media.caption: Hamas denounces Israel for killing a top Gaza police official in targeted strike
